name: Catherine Kerkow
bio: Catherine Kerkow was a Black Panther affiliate who in 1972, hijacked Western Airlines Flight 701 with accomplice Willie Roger Holder, demanding freedom for political prisoner Angela Davis and safe passage to North Vietnam in exchange for the release of the plane and its passengers. They ultimately received $500,000 in ransom and fled to Algeria where they were granted political asylum. In 1975, she and Holder were arrested attempting to enter France. French authorities refused to extradite her on the grounds that her crimes were politically motivated and released her after several months. In 1977 she fled to Switzerland and has not been seen since. She is currently wanted by the FBI as a fugitive.
